system: A sealed evolution experiment and its page: small rule-based readers of damaged seal codes are bred, battled and selected by a tested kernel, graded by rules against committed data. The data includes replies a vision model gave in another repository's sealed run; this build calls no model, and the page runs none and collects nothing.

aiAct.why: No AI system (Art 3(1)): the build runs no model that infers its outputs, so the AI Act places no duty on it.

gdpr.why: No personal data is processed, so no GDPR / UK GDPR duty arises from the build.
